archetypes.name: dyn-ledger-gap
archetypes.rationale: Ledger target gaps can subtly affect detailed and summary deltas.
archetypes.prompt_body: Inspect the skill-closure ledger changes around disappeared and reappearing targets. Check that last_values is cleared at the right point, adjacent revisions still compute normal deltas, and summary behavior remains intentional for removed targets. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
